results.remedy: Elevated: New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'NIPT-CBH HTTPS (LAN)' -Direction Inbound -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 19862 -Action Allow -Profile Domain,Private -RemoteAddress <hospital subnet>. Never open PostgreSQL, web, or renderer ports.
The HTTPS front listens on 127.0.0.1 by default; LAN publication is a hospital IT decision (set NIPT_HTTPS_HOST).
A server should have a static address or a DHCP reservation so the certificate name and clients keep working.

Audit timestamps and the 5-second HIS polling depend on synchronized time (domain controller or the hospital NTP server).
Receive times and LN Halos month boundaries use Asia/Bangkok; the host time zone should be SE Asia Standard Time.
Provide the hospital certificate (.cer) to check validity, name and chain.
Task List PDFs are rendered by the desktop Microsoft Excel (A4, locked template). Install Office/Excel on the host (licensed by the hospital).

results.detail: Excel automation is not supported from a service or SYSTEM session (session 0). With a SYSTEM startup task use -ExcelMode bridge and a logged-on interactive user running the bridge task; with -TaskMode user the services run in that user session.
